summary: Configure which admission heads are applicable at specific stages of the admission process, define default amounts, and control whether these amounts are editable during collection.
steps: Navigate to 'Stage Setup' and 'View' the specific admission stage where you want to enable transactions (e.g., 'Lead Stage').
Go to the 'Transactions' tab within the stage configuration.
Ensure 'Transaction Required' is enabled for the stage.
Select the relevant 'Course' for which the transaction applies.
Enter the default 'Amount' for this head.
- If 'Editable' is ON, users can modify the amount during collection.
- If 'Editable' is OFF, the amount will be fixed as entered here.
To apply this mapping to other courses, use the 'Copy Course Head' option.
Repeat steps 4-8 for any additional admission heads or courses required at this stage.
Click 'Update' or 'Save' to apply the changes to the stage configuration.
business_rules: Transactions must be enabled ('Transaction Required' ON) for a stage to allow amount collection.
Multiple admission heads can be mapped to a single stage, or different heads can be mapped to different stages.
The 'Editable' setting determines if the amount can be changed at the time of collection.
important_notes: Carefully consider whether an amount should be 'Editable' or fixed based on business policy.
The 'Copy Course Head' feature saves time when mapping the same head and amount across multiple courses.
Transaction history for an application can be viewed from the application's details.
questions: How do I link an admission head to a specific admission stage?
